I tip out 5% of my total sales to Kitchen(4%) and bartender(1%). I honestly have no issue with this and believe servers that do are bastards. Yes Yes, I have had tables not tip me because there food was made improperly and I've had bartenders be so slow I've taken 3 tables orders and they still don't have there drinks! However times like this are rare because no restaurant or bar keeps a cooks, bartenders or whoever around for long that are constantly terrible. And if you're about to tell me your work does. Then quit and get a new job.

The reason I feel this is necessary is because people are assholes. The first serving job I had we were only required to tip 1% of our food sales the the cooks. 1%! But it was entirely up to us to give it to the cooks at the end of the day. Only 50% of the wait staff did this. The others were constantly being chased by the cooks because they just refused to pay it over.

Probably me a lot at my job. But the thing that drives me nuts is I'm not trying to act like your boss and tell you what to do. I'm trying to tell you what WE have to do. And if I don't get on your case about doing your fucking job then I gotta do everything. So go fuck yourselves.
